meta.name: GQA-100 spatial benchmark (Exp-07 dataset)
meta.method: large graph (full original) -> tight anchor-pair subgraph -> compact small graph (anchors + query + answer + <=3 distractors; edges from tight subgraph only, core-touching, deduped) -> exactly one unique-answer query per image; between-queries from bbox centre geometry; self-relations and contradictory left/right pairs excluded from query generation
